program:

    stack card gap 1 tap edit r

        plural(r.to_day - r.from_day + 1, "day") faint
      r.from_day "to" r.to_day faint

Leave requests, in the ocean colours.

      - text: the plural of the to day of the req minus the from day of the req plus 1.

program:
app "Pantry" food mint
table ingredient name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, price money?, kind pick Big|Small|Spare
state q text = ""
let short = count(ingredient, it.qty <= it.low)
short "ingredients running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each ingredient where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(ingredient, it.qty * it.price) faint
form ingredient
describe:
Pantry, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- ingredient: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 5; price: money, optional; kind: one of Big, Small, Spare. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the ingredient have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "ingredients running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each ingredient where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the ingredient for editing; a swipe removes the ingredient, with undo:
    - text: the name of the ingredient.
    - text: the kind of the ingredient.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the ingredient to the qty of the ingredient minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the ingredient.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the ingredient to the qty of the ingredient plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the ingredient.
- a form to add a ingredient.

program:
app "Badminton" ball ocean
table point side pick Left|Right
table setwon side pick Left|Right
let l = count(point where side = Left)
let r = count(point where side = Right)
setting target num = 21 "Points per set"
let over = (l >= target or r >= target) and abs(l - r) >= 2
grid 2 gap 2
  stack card align center pad 3 fill soft tap add point side = Left
    "Left" faint
    l big
  stack card align center pad 3 fill soft tap add point side = Right
    "Right" faint
    r big
if over
  if(l > r, "Left", "Right") "wins the set" head color good
  button "Next set" tap add setwon side = if(l > r, Left, Right) then remove all point
else
  if(l = r, "Level", if(l > r, "Left leads", "Right leads")) faint

table milk litres num 0.5..50 unit "L", time pick Morning|Evening
setting price money = 180 "Price per litre"
"Today" sum(milk.litres today) "L" big
"This month" sum(milk.litres month) "L =" sum(milk.litres month) * price bold
daybars last 7 days, sum(milk.litres on it)
form milk
list milk last 7 days by day
describe:
Milk Yield, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- milk: litres: number, 0.5 to 50, in L; time: one of Morning, Evening. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Price per litre": money, starts at 180.
Shows:
- text: "Today", the total litres of milk today, "L".
- text: "This month", the total litres of milk this month, "L =", the total litres of milk this month times price.
- a bar chart of the total litres of milk on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
- a form to add a milk.
- a list of milk in the last 7 days by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: terse like a search query, 2 to 6 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words
order: start with the problem or reason

program:
app "Quran Buddy" book mint
table read juz num 1..30, pages num 1..
setting daily num = 4 "Pages a day"
let done = sum(read.pages)
goal done, 604, "pages read", "pages"
grid 10 gap 1
  each 1..30
    box height 22 radius 4 fill if(it <= max(read.juz), accent, soft)
      it tiny align center
"Today" sum(read.pages today) "of" daily "pages" faint
heat last 28 days, sum(read.pages on it), daily
"At this pace you finish in" round((604 - done) * 30 / sum(read.pages last 30 days)) "days" faint
form read
list read by day
describe:
Quran Buddy, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- read: juz: number, 1 to 30; pages: number, at least 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Pages a day": number, starts at 4.
Works out:
- done is the total pages of read.
Shows:
- done out of 604 with a progress bar, labelled "pages read".
- a grid of 10 columns:
  - for each number from 1 to 30:
    - text: the number.
- text: "Today", the total pages of read today, "of", daily, "pages".
- a heat map of the total pages of read on that day for each day in the last 28 days.
- text: "At this pace you finish in", the result of 604 minus done times 30 divided by the total pages of read in the last 30 days rounded, "days".
- a form to add a read.
- a list of read by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the numbers or units

program:
app "My Borrowed" key slate
table loan tool text, who text, lent date = today, back bool
count(loan where back = no) "things still out" head
each loan where back = no sort lent as l
  row card gap 2 tap edit l
    stack grow
      l.tool bold
      l.who "for" today - l.lent "days" small color if(today - l.lent > 14, bad, muted)
    button "Got it back" tap set l.back = yes
form loan, "Lend something"
"Returned" faint
list loan where back = yes
describe:
My Borrowed, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- loan: tool: text; who: text; lent: date, starts at today; back: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: how many loan entries where back is no, "things still out".
- for each loan where back is no sorted by lent:
  - a group; a tap opens the loan for editing:
    - text: the tool of the loan.
    - text: the who of the loan, "for", today minus the lent of the loan, "days".
    - a button "Got it back"; a tap sets the back of the loan to yes.
- a form to add a loan.
- text: "Returned".
- a list of loan where back is yes; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Support desk" bell slate
table ticket subject text, prio pick Low|High|Urgent = Low, open bool = yes, note long?
count(ticket where open = yes and prio = Urgent) "urgent" big color if(count(ticket where open = yes and prio = Urgent) > 0, bad, ink)
each ticket where open = yes and prio = Urgent as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t
    toggle t.open
    t.subject bold grow
each ticket where open = yes and prio != Urgent sort at as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t
    toggle t.open
    t.subject grow
    t.prio faint
form ticket, "New ticket"
describe:
Support desk, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- ticket: subject: text; prio: one of Low, High, Urgent, starts at Low; open: yes or no, starts at yes; note: long text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: how many ticket entries where open is yes and prio is Urgent, "urgent".
- for each ticket where open is yes and prio is Urgent:
  - a group; a tap opens the ticket for editing:
    - a tick box for the open of the ticket.
    - text: the subject of the ticket.
- for each ticket where open is yes and prio is not Urgent sorted by at:
  - a group; a tap opens the ticket for editing:
    - a tick box for the open of the ticket.
    - text: the subject of the ticket.
    - text: the prio of the ticket.
- a form to add a ticket.
hurried_style: lowercase with one or two typos, 3 to 10 words
fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first
order: start with who it is for

program:
app "Habits" check mint
table done habit pick Walk|Read|Write|Stretch
goal count(done today), 4, "habits today"
each options done.habit as h
  row card gap 2
    h bold grow
    streak(done where habit = h) "days" faint
    toggle done today where habit = h
"Perfect days in the last 30" count(days last 30 days, count(done on it) = 4) faint
describe:
Habits, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- done: habit: one of Walk, Read, Write, Stretch. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- how many done entries today out of 4 with a progress bar, labelled "habits today".
- for each choice of the habit of the done:
  - text: the choice.
  - text: the current day streak of done entries where habit is the choice, "days".
  - a tick box for done where habit is the choice today.
- text: "Perfect days in the last 30", how many of the day in the last 30 days have how many done entries on that day is 4.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Library visits" book mint
table visit
setting target num = 3 "Count to"
let n = count(visit today)
draw width 240 tap add visit
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * (n % target) / target stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n % target big
  label 50, 64, "Round" floor(n / target) + 1 faint
stat count(visit), "all time"
remind "Time for library visits" at 7:30
describe:
Library visits, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- visit: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Count to": number, starts at 3.
Works out:
- n is how many visit entries today.
Shows:
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels; a tap adds a visit.
- a big number: how many visit entries, labelled "all time".
Reminder "Time for library visits" at 7:30 every day.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: start with the problem or reason
